answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a scarce, verifiable resource before it may transact, like a reef that only grows where coral has truly settled. Reputation then accrues slowly through attested work, so an attacker flooding the ocean with fresh accounts pays real compute, stake, and time per identity. Quartz is the test: a transparent ledger lets peers verify each history is genuine crystal, not painted glass, and cheap copies collapse under inspection before extracting value.
